{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|chuck]], trimmed and cut into 1½-inch cubes
* 8 ounces [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|sirloin]], trimmed and cut into 1½-inch cubes
* [[Cookbook:Steak Rub|Steak Rub]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 4 hamburger buns, halved
* 4 slices of your favorite [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (e.g. pepper jack)
* Favorite toppings

== Procedure ==
#Pass meat cubes through a meat grinder set to fine. Once all ground, mix and form into 4 patties.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] patties with olive oil and sprinkle liberally with Steak Rub.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] on high for about 3–4 minutes per side for medium rare, 5–6 for medium, and 7–8 for well-done. During the last minute, place one slice of cheese on top.
#Remove and place one patty on top of each bottom half of halved buns.
#Top with your favorite condiments and finish with the top half. Serve.
